description: Activate when: user says 'where should we grow next', 'should we enter a new market', 'thinking about diversifying', 'new product vs new market', 'growth strategy', 'adjacent expansion', 'Ansoff', or is spreading resources across too many directions at once. Do NOT activate when: the firm has one clear unsaturated market (answer is always penetration — no matrix needed); or the question is about portfolio allocation across existing BUs (use BCG Matrix instead). More: deciqai.com/c/ansoff-matrix
